title: Surreal Eye of Time
description: A woman in a white and red dress sits on a blue chaise lounge holding a lit candle, gazing toward a large detailed eye from which a swirling clock face with bugs and symbols emerges. In the foreground, a rat stands on a yellow lily pad near black handprints and a pile of black powder, with a cracked window showing a sunset landscape in the background.
prompt: Surreal symbolic artwork of a pale woman in flowing white dress with red trim sitting on a blue vintage chaise lounge, holding a lit candle, large intricate human eye emerging from her gaze with a swirling clock face spiral containing various bugs, insects, and symbols, a brown rat standing on a yellow lily pad in the foreground, black handprints and pile of black dust on the floor, cracked arched window in the background revealing a broken icy landscape with a setting sun, detailed line art with watercolor washes and bokeh lights
